lines: This repo has 705 GitHub stars for watching ads play over rough drafts.
Every ad starts as a rough plan with ideas for sections and timing. Then each move lands perfectly.
NullMotion lets you watch a finished motion-graphics ad play over the rough drafts it grew from.
It runs a small HyperFrames engine where each draft is an HTML scene on a paused GSAP timeline.
Export a finished ad over its roughs then save that full sequence as one MP4.
Run it locally with Node 22+ and export using Chrome or Edge.
The HyperFrames engine is open source with no dependencies, and you can join their Discord community.
Clone it and run npm start.
Save this for later or send it to someone building ads.
Stop editing roughs and watch NullMotion.
